item: 6.9 Mention chips — @file mentions in a sent message render as inline capsules (2026-09-04)
branch: addUserMessage() decorates every path-shaped @-token (contains a slash or a dotted extension, preceded by start-of-text or whitespace) as <span class="mention" data-path>; the bubble's textContent is byte-identical to the typed prompt (decoration only), and non-path @-tokens (an email's host, a bare @decorator) stay plain
provenance: The text is what OUR composer sends — a raw `@relative/path` inserted by the 6.1 picker (65-slash.js pick()), never transformed on the way out; the CLI expands @-mentions itself. Both live (sendTurn) and replay (55-replay.js user items) draw the bubble through the same addUserMessage builder, so one path proves the renderer; the trailing-punctuation strip and the email/decorator guards are the RULE this fixture pins, not a wire shape. Modelled on VS Code 2.1.260's inputMentionChip / mentionChip pills (full-surface audit 2026-09-04). Negative control: on the pre-6.9 build the bubble is one text node — chip count 0, and the guards are vacuous (all counts 0) — so only the count and data-path asserts are DISCRIMINATING.

steps.note: one bubble with two path mentions (one sentence-final with a trailing period), an email and a bare @decorator
steps.setup: window.__mc74 = (function () { window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({type:'__clear'})); const txt = 'Refactor @src/components/App.tsx and @lib/util.js. Mail a@b.com about it; the @decorator stays plain, so does @src alone'; const d = addUserMessage(txt, []); const chips = Array.prototype.slice.call(d.querySelectorAll('.mention')); return { chips: chips.length, texts: chips.map(function (c) { return c.textContent; }), paths: chips.map(function (c) { return c.dataset.path; }), textSame: d.textContent === txt, plainEmail: d.textContent.indexOf('a@b.com') !== -1 && !chips.some(function (c) { return c.textContent.indexOf('b.com') !== -1; }), bubbles: document.querySelectorAll('#log .msg-user').length }; })();

expect.why: DISCRIMINATING: exactly the two path-shaped mentions become chips (pre-fix: 0) — the email host, the bare @decorator and the extension-less @src stay plain
DISCRIMINATING: the chip keeps the typed token including its @; the sentence-final period is NOT swallowed into the second chip
DISCRIMINATING: data-path carries the bare project-relative path, the same idiom the delegated #log click handler opens in the editor
GUARD: decoration never changes the bubble's text — copy/select still yields exactly the prompt that was sent
GUARD: an email address is not a mention (the @ is not preceded by whitespace)
